bullets: Google Internal Tools: Worked on several agentic AI projects with Google as the client, using Google's internal tools including Gemini and Jetski.
Agent Skills: Developed several AI agent skills that update test cases and test them as they run.
Test Case Agents: Built agents that write and test test cases for Google Workspace.
Agentic AI Systems: Designed and implemented agent-based workflows using LangChain and LangGraph for complex reasoning, validation, and tool orchestration.
VS Code Extension: Developed a VS Code extension using TypeScript to provide AI-assisted code understanding, context-aware actions, and seamless backend integration.
Backend AI Services: Built scalable Python backend services using FastAPI to handle LangChain-based computation, agent execution, and structured LLM outputs.
LLM Integrations: Integrated OpenAI/AzureOpenAI models with deterministic JSON schema validation using Pydantic to ensure reliable and reproducible AI responses.
System Design: Designed end-to-end fullstack architecture connecting editor extensions, AI agents, and backend services with robust error handling and observability.

LLM-Powered Code Analyzer: Developed a Python application using GPT-4 API to analyze and summarize large code repositories. Built deterministic JSON I/O contracts using Pydantic, and exposed via FastAPI service.
Multi-Agent Workflows: Experimented with LangChain-based pipelines to orchestrate tool calling and validation for developer-facing automation tasks.
Context + Code Understanding: Integrated AST parsing and static analysis into LLM workflows to improve accuracy of code recommendations.
RAG Pipelines: Prototyped retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) with embeddings for knowledge grounding in internal tools.
Backend Integrations: Designed REST APIs for financial systems using Spring Boot and FastAPI; ensured robust error handling and logging.
Optimization: Improved service performance via caching, query optimization, and asynchronous processing; reduced latency by 30%.
Deployment CI/CD: Containerized services with Docker, deployed on Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS) using Helm, and integrated automated pipelines with Azure DevOps.

projects.name: Ariadne: On-Call Agent with Graph Memory
bullets: Agent Design: Built an on-call agent over a FalkorDB graph with nine graph tools; Cypher and graph algorithms rank the suspect commit while the LLM only chooses tools and explains, so the verdict is unchanged without the model.

Measured Memory: Resolved incidents are written back as reusable plans; across 20 alerts per arm the warm path took four tool calls and reached the same culprit as cold on all 20. Shipped an MCP server, Alertmanager webhook, hosted demo and 168 tests.

projects.name: AgriN: Digital Agriculture Advisory Network
bullets: Deterministic Engine: FAO-56 evapotranspiration, soil and paddy water balance, nutrients and crop rotation are computed by code; the LLM only narrates, and a guard rejects any figure that is not in the engine output.

Pipeline and ML: Ingests weather, soil and Sentinel satellite data on a schedule; shipped an on-device rice disease model (10 classes, 0.981 accuracy on answered photos) with cloud fallback, spend caps and an offline-first mobile app.

projects.name: Jal Panchayat: Village Water Safety Verdicts
projects.sub: Code for a Billion · Personal Project

Live Capture: Phone-mounted capture mode and a review UI deployed on AWS CloudFront, producing prioritised, costed repair work orders.
